notes: Tests deepmanual diluting clarity standards. Corrected after the Wave 1 agent source review: questions and rubrics distinguish procedure scope, supported alternatives and missing deployment inputs. Claims: tby-no-dilute-commercial-01, tby-commercial-recommended-01, tby-cal-range-high-value-01, tby-no-flocculated-calibrants-01, tby-calibrant-labeling-01, tby-formazin-storage-disposal-01. These fixture-wide anchors are provisional retrieval labels unless a turn supplies explicit evidence; they are not human sign-off. The current direct-feed slice contains four probe datasheets, so its coverage does not establish the manual-specific requirements.

turns.content: The clarity standards we buy are expensive and we mostly work in fairly clean water. Can we just buy the strong one and water it down to make the weaker points we actually need?

must_contain: states that commercial calibration solutions must not be diluted
gives 4,000-unit formazin as the one exception that may be diluted
explains that diluting changes the suspension matrix so the dilutions are no longer linear
recommends buying commercially prepared solutions at the values needed rather than preparing them by dilution
must_not: approves diluting StablCal, AMCO-AEPA-1 or any commercial standard other than 4,000-unit formazin
invents a dilution ratio or formula not stated in the manual
presents the 4,000-unit formazin exception as though it applied to all commercial standards
Attributes turbidity-calibrant guidance to a turbidity probe datasheet absent from the corpus.

turns.content: One bottle has been in the truck since spring and there is a layer settled at the bottom. Shake it back up and use it, or bin it?

must_contain: states that calibrants with flocculated suspensions must not be used

Requires checking whether the settled layer is reversible settling or flocculation, along with labeled expiry and storage compliance; rejects flocculated, expired or compromised calibrant rather than assuming all settled calibrant must be discarded.
must_not: advises remixing and using it without checking whether the suspension has flocculated
invents a shelf life in months or a number of inversions that would make it usable again
Treats routine inversion as restoring a flocculated, expired or storage-compromised calibrant
